title: …Before the Solstice…
program_note:
...Before the Solstice... was originally written for flute and guitar.  It was commissioned by Kristin Taavola, and is dedicated to her and William Anderson, who gave the first performance of the original version on February 28, 1999.

The two roughly-equal-length movements, contrasting driving rhythmic and metric energy with calmer reverie, total a bit more than 9 minutes in duration.

In the first movement, Ritual Dance, a symmetrical mode sets the stage for rhythmic patterns placed within changing meters.  This set up an opposition between those short, driving rhythmic patterns and longer held notes, the latter of which lead to sinuous (vaguely middle-eastern?) melodic lines, replete with ornamentations and pitch bends, prior to a return to the frenzy of the opening.Exhausted by the energy of the first movement, the second movement, Sunrise Song, relaxes the mixture of semitones and minor thirds into a mode heavier with major seconds and perfect fifths.  Large harp chords and ornamentations continue from the first movement, but without the microtonal or improvisational energy of the first movement — even a brief foray into octatonicsm only serves to add a dash of intensity to what is otherwise a calm awakening after a night of revelry.
